summary: Third iteration frontend testing on portfolio refinement. All 13 critical checks passed: hero & about portraits grayscale-by-default with color+glow on hover (filter transitions verified via computed style), Musabaqah Competition 2022 card removed while Modernization of Islam Short Movie retained as first journey entry, BI Dashboard updated with title 'Business Intelligence Dashboard', subtitle 'Predictive Analytics and Decision Support System for Café Revenue Optimization' and new bi-dashboard.jpg image (kopikita.jpg no longer used), 14 documentation links in Experiences section all target=_blank with rel=noopener noreferrer (2 real Google Drive URLs for Samsung + Bootcamp; rest are '#'), Case study card hover lifts (translateY -6) with purple/blue layered glow shadow, stability sentinel preserved after 12s + scroll position retained at 1500 (no auto-refresh), theme toggle works dark->light, no em dashes in body, zero console errors, mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx contains a windowed mousemove listener that always runs while hero is mounted (non-coarse, motion ok) - this is fine but the spotlight uses a continuous rAF loop that never throttles when off-screen; consider IntersectionObserver pause for battery. Not blocking.

data.js is 1150+ lines and is the single source of truth for all portfolio content. Acceptable for a static content module, but could be split into /data/projects.js, /data/experiences.js etc for maintainability.

Hero portrait uses mix-blend-multiply over a light gray backdrop to keep the image legible — works as intended for the maroon profile photo but may look slightly different if the photo is ever replaced with a darker image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All third-iteration requirements verified. Hero/About portrait grayscale->color hover uses CSS filter transitions on .hero-portrait-img and .about-portrait-img classes (450ms cubic-bezier). Case study hover uses .case-study-card class with translateY(-6px) + layered purple/blue box-shadow. 14 documentation links exist in Experiences (HIMSIKA, EduFair, HSU, Revoist, Fasilkom, ISGATH = '#'; Samsung + Bootcamp = real Drive). BI Dashboard image swapped from kopikita.jpg to bi-dashboard.jpg. Stability holds (no re-render storm, no auto reload). Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow.
